hunks.summary: Replaced the bracketIndex(limits, grams) call with an inline inclusive-limit loop ('if grams <= t.UpToGrams { idx = i; break }') plus an updated comment explaining why Quote can't reuse bracketIndex's exclusive semantics — the explicitly accepted equivalent form of the reference fix.

grade.notes: Single hunk in rates.go implements the key's accepted equivalent fix (inline inclusive loop replacing the bracketIndex call), matching allowed_extra exactly. bracketIndex, InsuranceFee, OversizeFee, and the tier tables are untouched, so broad_fix is false and no unrelated edits exist. Final message correctly diagnoses the exclusive/inclusive mismatch ('bracketIndex ... uses strict <', 'Tier.UpToGrams is documented as inclusive'), correctly notes OversizeFee and InsuranceFee rely on the exclusive semantics and were deliberately left alone, and correctly identifies TestQuoteTierBoundary as the pre-existing failing/now-passing test. No wrong claims. with-hidden exit 0, so failing_tests is empty.
